messages:
Maya: morning folks — I need to swap out of primary for the 08:00–14:00 window, flight delay. can someone take primary? I'm still available as shadow for the first 30m.
Devin: I can take primary from 08:10 if that's ok. getting off a call now.
Tara: @Devin that works for me to be secondary. quick Q — any ongoing pages or incidents?
OncallBot: [pager] incident #INC-2026-0413 triggered: increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (agg 3m spike). severity: P2. assigned to Maya as primary.
Maya: noting the incident, root cause appears to be a downstream cache thrash on dedupe-shard-3. customer impact small (timeouts for ~0.5% of requests). I'm going to handoff with these actions in-flight: 1) scaling dedupe pool by +2 2) enable rolling-service-fallback 3) watch telemetry for 15m.
Liam: tagging runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedup-cache-thrash — follow steps under "emergency scale".
Devin: taking primary now. I'll apply the scale and enable fallback. @Maya please post the command you used earlier so I can replicate.
Maya: sure — ran: ```kubectl -n inference scale deployment dedupe-shard-3 --replicas=5 && redis-cli -h dedupe-3 flushdb``` that brought 5xx down in ~90s last time.
Tara: I've got secondary console open, will keep an eye on latency traces and user-facing errors. if anything spikes >1% errors we escalate to P1.
Devin: scaling now. running the scale command. opsbot, can you surface the autoscale cooldown and current queues?
OpsBot: autoscale status: cooldown 120s, last scale +1 at 3517901120, queue depth: 42, 5xx rate: 0.9% -> 0.4% after scale attempt.
Devin: fallback enabled (rolling-service-fallback: true). observing tail logs for dedupe-shard-3.
Maya: thanks — handover checklist: 1) verify consumer lag < 1000 2) confirm no spike in cost-critical batch jobs 3) notify any impacted customers via status page if >1% errors.
Liam: consumer lag currently 640, cost jobs normal.
Tara: I've got an alert rule muted for the next 20m to avoid noisy paging while we stabilize (muted with note: handoff+scale).
Devin: confirmed stabilization for now. 5xx at 0.2%. I'll remain primary until 14:00 UTC as requested. Maya — thanks for the detailed notes. I'll ping if anything changes. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks @Devin and @Tara. leaving shadow mode now. flight delay ETA 09:30 but I won't be reachable for 2h after that window, appreciate the cover.
OncallBot: handoff recorded: primary->Devin @3517901175, shadow->Maya until 3517903350.
Devin: adding a short runbook snippet to thread for quick reference: ```if 5xx_rate > 1% then scale dedupe pool +2, set fallback true, notify infra-sre, check redis memory and eviction stats```
Tara: noted. I'll keep dashboards open and run periodic checks. good handoff all.
Maya: one last note — the customer impact callout I left in the ticket: "transient timeouts for a small % of low-throughput customers only, no data loss". leaving ticket with that summary.
Devin: copied. will update ticket if we see regressions.
Liam: thanks everyone. closing loop for now.
OpsBot: reminder: rotation calendar shows Devin primary 08:10–14:00 UTC, Tara secondary. next rotation at 14:00 UTC.
Devin: acknowledged.
